brief: Cycle camera presets or mode-table selections for a viewport.
decl: void record_selection_cycle(RecordMachine &machine, std::span<const std::byte> pairs, std::span<const std::byte, 36> modes, std::span<const std::byte, 12> context, std::uint32_t mode, std::uint32_t &counter0, std::uint32_t &counter1, std::span<const std::byte> subjects, std::uint32_t viewport);

bookkeeping.scope: Complete controller body, actual recovered children, and declared observation/mutation substitutions for callback handlers.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Stable caller-owned arena and nonnull current record. Mode uses its low byte. Disjoint terminated pairs, nine mode words, context, checked current/reference subject entries, and distinct external counters. Mode cycling must terminate and all resulting signed table indexes must be nonnegative; initial minus one and large positive indexes can be valid after wrapping/remainder.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 3192 complete original-body cases exact on MSVC and Zig/Clang under declared callback substitutions; eight separate six-call lifecycle traces also match. See docs/recovery/camera-cycling.md.
unresolved: Actual callback bodies, authentic UI/input producers, and integrated camera updates.
Negative mode-table accesses, invalid subject table reads, original faults and nonterminating cycles.
